title: Kadhal
desc: Aishwarya, a young student from a wealthy family, falls in love with Murugan, a scooter mechanic. She convinces him to elope with her, but things take a drastic turn when her family tracks them down.

title: Poovellam Un Vasam
desc: Chinna and Chella, two childhood friends from neighbouring families, end up falling in love with each other. Soon, a misunderstanding leads to a rift between them and their families.

title: Thiruvilayadal Arambam
desc: Guru hatches several plans to separate Priya and her lover Thirukumaran. However, Thirukumaran successfully manages to escape from Guru's evil plans and traps him in another problem.

title: Dev
desc: Dev, an adventure enthusiast, falls in love with Meghna, an entrepreneur with a troubled past and insecurities. As a result, his life changes.

title: Deepavali
desc: A rich woman gets exploited by her relatives after she loses her son. Her troubles vanish after Ravi treats her like his mother and protects her from the wicked people.
